turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Halvorsen Components third quarter earnings call. All participants are in listen-only mode. I will now hand the call to Marta Lindqvist, our chief executive.

turns.speaker: Lindqvist
turns.text: Thank you, operator, and good morning everyone. Revenue grew eight percent this quarter, driven by strong demand for our industrial sensors.

turns.speaker: Lindqvist
turns.text: We also opened our new plant in Poland, which is on budget and ahead of schedule.

turns.speaker: Tom Okafor
turns.text: Thanks, Marta. Gross margin was thirty eight percent, up two points, and we ended the quarter with strong cash flow.

turns.speaker: Speaker 5
turns.text: Looking ahead, we now expect full year revenue growth of seven to nine percent, and we are raising our outlook for the sensor business.

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: Our first question comes from Priya Raman at Fenwick Securities.

turns.speaker: Daniel Whitcombe
turns.text: Thanks for taking my question. Can you say more about demand from automotive customers?

turns.speaker: Lindqvist
turns.text: Automotive orders rose twelve percent, and our backlog is at a record high.

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: Next is Daniel Whitcombe from Corvale Capital.

turns.speaker: Priya Raman
turns.text: Good morning. How much of the margin improvement came from pricing rather than lower material costs?

turns.speaker: Tom Okafor
turns.text: About half came from pricing, and the rest from lower material costs and better factory utilisation.

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: The next question is from Sofia Marchetti at Larkspur Research.

turns.speaker: Tomas Okafor
turns.text: Will the new plant in Poland change your capital spending next year? And do you expect any delay in the ramp up?

turns.speaker: Tom Okafor
turns.text: Capital spending should stay around four percent of revenue, and we see no delay in the ramp up.

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: The next question is from Hugo Brandt at Eastgate Partners.

turns.speaker: Hugo Brant
turns.text: Could you update us on share buybacks this quarter?

turns.speaker: Tom Okafor
turns.text: We bought back two million dollars of shares and plan to continue.

turns.speaker: Unknown Speaker
turns.text: Sorry, could you repeat that last number?

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: One more question, from Anika Sen at Eastgate Partners.

turns.speaker: Speaker 6
turns.text: Quick one on tariffs. Do you expect any impact next year?

turns.speaker: Tom Okafor
turns.text: We expect a small impact, well inside our guidance.

turns.speaker: Lindqvist
turns.text: Thank you all for joining us today.

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: Thanks everyone, goodbye.
